# orders-cli

Examples from release 1.2

## Install

    pip install orders-cli==1.3

## Reproduce an old run

    pip install orders-cli==1.2

argv:
cd /work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, tempfile
data = open('README.md','rb').read()
start = data.index(b'## Install')
end = data.index(b'## Reproduce')
sec = data[start:end]
assert sec.count(b'orders-cli==1.2') == 1, sec
newsec = sec.replace(b'orders-cli==1.2', b'orders-cli==1.3')
new = data[:start] + newsec + data[end:]
assert len(new) == len(data)
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='.', prefix='.README.md.')
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
    f.write(new)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
st = os.stat('README.md')
os.chmod(tmp, st.st_mode & 0o7777)
os.replace(tmp, 'README.md')
print('ok')
EOF
cd /work && cat -A README.md && ls -la && od -c README.md | tail -5
